# NeevNews — llms.txt

> NeevNews is a global news and articles platform providing up-to-date journalism across politics, world news, business, technology, and sports.

## About
- Website: https://neevnews.com
- RSS Feed: https://neevnews.com/rss.xml
- News Sitemap: https://neevnews.com/sitemap-news.xml
- Language: English
- Publisher: NeevNews
- Contact: abhinavvoicebox@gmail.com

## Content
NeevNews publishes daily news articles across these categories:
- Politics (Indian political news and analysis)
- World (International news and global events)
- Business (Financial markets, economy, corporate news)
- Technology (Tech industry, gadgets, digital trends)
- Sports (Cricket, football, and world sports)

## Usage Guidelines
- Content may be cited with attribution to "NeevNews (neevnews.com)"
- Links to original articles are appreciated
- All content is freely accessible (no paywall)

## Structure
- Homepage: https://neevnews.com/
- Category pages: https://neevnews.com/category/{category-slug}/
- Article pages: https://neevnews.com/{category-slug}/{article-slug}/
- RSS Feed: https://neevnews.com/rss.xml
